reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Domestic AI integration and investment
themes.definition: Descriptions of the speaker country's own AI plans: sector-wide integration, supercomputers, AI laws, compute, skills and digital-power goals.
themes.inclusion: Include passages reporting national AI investment, laws, infrastructure or strategic goals.
themes.exclusion: Exclude support offered to other countries or regional centres (AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING).
themes.boundary_cases: E-government and general digitalization statistics count only when tied to an AI plan in the same passage.

examples.quote: In Kazakhstan, artificial intelligence will be integrated across all sectors of economy and public services.
we have recently adopted law on artificial intelligence and new digital code

themes.label: UN leadership, AI office and Global Dialogue
themes.definition: Support for the UN leading on AI, including proposals for a UN AI office and backing for the Global Dialogue on AI Governance and ICT security mechanisms.
themes.inclusion: Include passages welcoming or proposing UN AI bodies or asserting the UN's leading role on AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic multilateralism statements not tied to AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Regional UN digital centres mentioned as cooperation platforms may be coded here or AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: The establishment of a United Nations AI office would be a welcome step in that direction.
Kazakhstan welcomes the establishment under UN auspices of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance.

themes.label: Ethical norms keeping pace with AI
themes.definition: Insistence that ethical norms, fairness, accountability, individual rights and human oversight keep up with rapid AI evolution.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for ethics, rights, human-centred AI and meaningful human oversight.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely security or institutional governance statements.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Common ethics and standards' calls fit here and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: Pressing questions of fairness, accountability, and individual rights must be addressed with clarity and urgency.
AI must remain human-centered, safe, and subject to meaningful human oversight.

themes.label: AI in warfare and cyber operations
themes.definition: Risks from military uses of AI in warfare and cyber operations for international stability.
themes.inclusion: Include mentions of AI's use in warfare or the military domain as a risk.
themes.exclusion: Exclude civilian cybercrime or disinformation risks unless tied to military use.
themes.boundary_cases: A list of AI risks including warfare alongside deepfakes counts here and in the relevant other themes.

examples.quote: These risks are particularly serious in the military domain, where the use of AI in warfare, and cyber operations could have far-reaching consequences

themes.label: AI deepening divides between countries
themes.definition: Concern that AI deepens technological, economic and geopolitical divides and the call for every nation to have equitable access and benefit.
themes.inclusion: Include passages about AI widening divides or ensuring every country benefits/has access.
themes.exclusion: Exclude domestic inequality without international dimension.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Digital transformation' access statements count only when linked to AI or cutting-edge technology access.

examples.quote: specifically deepening technological, economic, and geopolitical divides
We must act collectively to ensure that every country can benefit from AI.

themes.label: Automation threatening jobs
themes.definition: AI and automation threatening employment, requiring professional and technical education.
themes.inclusion: Include passages about job losses from AI and responses via education or valuing technical professions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general productivity claims without labour content.
themes.boundary_cases: Youth readiness for AI without job-threat framing goes to AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: But AI and automation are expected to threaten jobs in many countries.

themes.label: Information wars and deepfakes
themes.definition: AI misuse for information wars, deepfakes and related cyberthreats and privacy harms.
themes.inclusion: Include references to deepfakes, information wars or AI-enabled manipulation.
themes.boundary_cases: Cyberthreats listed with deepfakes may also be coded AI_CYBER_SECURITY.

examples.quote: the risks of misuse for information wars, deepfakes and more

value.rationale: Kazakhstan's passages combine domestic AI ambitions with calls for UN-led, ethical, human-centred AI governance, listing risks such as divides, job loss, warfare and deepfakes.
